name: OrbitCarousel
whenToUse: A showcase on a landing page: case studies, product shots, a few campaign cards.

whenNotToUse.text: Content people browse or compare in the product
More than ~10 cards, or cards with forms and long text

anatomy.description: `shape="drum"`: cards round a cylinder that turns on its vertical axis.
`shape="wheel"`: cards on the rim of a large wheel to the start side, rolling past vertically; up to three on each side, fading out.
Previous / Next; Pause when `autoplay` is set.

do.caption: Enough cards to read as a circle; each one makes sense on its own.

dont.caption: Too few to form a circle — use a plain Carousel.

a11y: One tab stop; ← / → (↑ / ↓ for the wheel) turn it; drag or swipe does the same.
Only the front card is in the accessibility tree; the others are aria-hidden and inert.
autoplay pauses on hover and focus and has a Pause button (WCAG 2.2.2).
prefers-reduced-motion: no turning animation and no autoplay.

props.name: autoplay
props.description: Turn on its own every `autoplay` ms. Off by default.

props.name: itemWidth
props.description: Card width in px (drum) or the card box width (wheel). Default 240.

props.name: onIndexChange
props.description: Called with the index of the card that comes to the front.
